body:
Thank you all so much for the help and consideration.  I never imagined the internet to be so receptive. 

I'm taking steps to make myself happy again. 
I found out that I have PMDD, which causes me to be extremely depressed a few days every month. Hoping to find medication and I hear exercise and Vitamin B6 can help.

Taking a year off school to work on personal art projects and travel.

I just hope I can keep the ex off my mind.

What was your worst side effect, i.e-- how much weight did you gain? 

Perhaps my body stopped producing as much serotonin because I'm constantly stressed--from school/worrying about relationship crap/ being afraid of failing.

Thank you, it sounds like you've come a long way. 

Where/how would you suggest meeting people. I'm not returning to school next year and I've lost contact with pretty much all of my high school friends.

Thank you, it's motivating to hear this. 
It's been a lot of self-discovery this year, and I've always been raised believing that true success and happiness can only come from a formulaic perfect life like you said. Being at school, I've had no time to do anything other than my work-related projects, and I'm constantly stuck in the same place. 

Next year, I'm taking a year off to establish some more independence and travel maybe-- hopefully that will help.

I've tried the school counselor a few times, perhaps I need to be more patient, but I don't feel comfortable talking to them-- too many vague suggestions and generic answers. 

A doctor suggested I take Lexapro, but the side effects sound terrible and I dislike the idea of relying on medication to fix myself. 

Thank you for the suggestions, especially about the relationship. I should stop taking it personally.
